sentences.ar: سألوا جحا: القمر أهم ولا الشمس؟
sentences.en: They asked Juha: is the moon more important or the sun?
Juha thought and said: the moon.
He said: because it comes out at night.
That is when we need light.
And the sun comes out in the day when the world is already light.
